- [Software Development Engineer Intern, Amazon Web Services](https://ruchirjadhav.dev/experience/aws-eks-metrics-backfill): metrics backfill system in Go for the Amazon EKS Metrics Service
- Data Engineer, BusinessNext (Sep 2023 to May 2024): SQL queries and data logic behind client-portfolio dashboards for a banking CRM (no detail page)

## Writing
- [Summarising pages four times faster by deleting the subprocesses](https://ruchirjadhav.dev/writing/summarising-pages-four-times-faster): replacing a subprocess per article with a plain request timeout gave the same summaries in a quarter of the time
- [Two ways a traffic controller can strand a car](https://ruchirjadhav.dev/writing/two-ways-a-traffic-controller-strands-a-car): two bugs in a reservation-based intersection controller, and the tests that caught them
- [Benchmarking a fact-checker on speech, not text](https://ruchirjadhav.dev/writing/benchmarking-a-fact-checker-on-speech): a 400-claim benchmark that exercises speech recognition and separates retrieval from memorization
- [Choosing an optimizer when routes must be computed on demand](https://ruchirjadhav.dev/writing/choosing-an-optimizer-under-a-time-budget): why Tabu Search beat Simulated Annealing in the published travel route optimizer
- [Coordination beats speed at an intersection](https://ruchirjadhav.dev/writing/coordination-beats-speed-at-an-intersection): a reservation protocol in the CARLA simulator cleared the queue faster than a traffic light, even at half speed
- [What a materialized view needs inside DuckDB](https://ruchirjadhav.dev/writing/what-a-materialized-view-needs-inside-duckdb): the parser, planner and executor changes needed to add materialized views
- [How this site is built](https://ruchirjadhav.dev/writing/how-this-site-is-built): the stack, the choices behind it, and the quality gates every push has to pass
- [Offloading bulk reading to Gemini from Claude Code](https://ruchirjadhav.dev/writing/offloading-reading-to-gemini): a small Node tool that hands long reads to Gemini, and the checks around its answers
